title: PRIV-004 Retention Policy Authority Contract
purpose: Define the minimum versioned policy authority required to deterministically resolve server-controlled retentionUntil without choosing any concrete legal retention duration in this contract.

rules: DURATION requires durationSeconds and forbids fixedUntil.
FIXED_UNTIL requires fixedUntil and forbids durationSeconds.
Exactly one rule mode is active for an approved policy instance.

evaluationRules: Resolve policy by authoritative scope and effective time.
Validate policyVersion and require an APPROVED or ACTIVE policy state before runtime use.
A consent record stores the selected policyVersion immutably.
Compute retentionUntil deterministically from the admitted policy rule and server clock.
The client cannot select retentionClass, duration, fixedUntil, or any other retention rule.
If no applicable approved policy instance exists, runtime MUST fail closed and MUST NOT persist a consent record whose retentionUntil is unresolved.
Policy changes require version increment under the global policy/config contract.
Historical consent records remain interpretable using their recorded policyVersion.
minimumAdmissionEvidence: policy instance with version and scope
nonAuthorizations: No concrete retention duration is selected here.
No jurisdiction-specific legal conclusion is selected here.
No runtime implementation is authorized by this contract alone.
